sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework: supporting high quality communications infrastructure
sources.role: National planning policy for electronic communications infrastructure.
sources.facts: NPPF paragraphs support high-quality fixed and mobile communications infrastructure and future network expansion.
sources.guard: National policy does not prove that a specific premise has service, capacity, permission or a deliverable connection.

sources.title: Reforming planning rules to accelerate deployment of digital infrastructure
sources.role: Government call for evidence on telecoms planning reform.
sources.facts: The document describes planning applications, permitted development rights and the Electronic Communications Code context.
sources.guard: A call for evidence and description of rights does not prove final rules, prior approval or permission at a particular site.

sources.title: July 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
sources.role: Current contract-level Project Gigabit administrative statistics.
sources.facts: Updated 20 July 2026; the release distinguishes contracted and built premises and warns about scope and ingestion lags.
sources.guard: Contract-level administrative figures do not prove current retail availability, service activation, speed or exact-premises eligibility.

sources.title: Premises contracted and built, Project Gigabit contracts
sources.role: Official monthly Project Gigabit publication collection.
sources.facts: The collection was updated 20 July 2026 and contains monthly contract-level releases.
sources.guard: A publication collection is not a complete or current parcel-level service register.

sources.title: Ofcom Connected Nations coverage data
sources.role: Ofcom fixed and mobile coverage dataset catalogue.
sources.facts: The National Data Library record was updated 8 July 2026 and describes broadband and mobile infrastructure coverage reports.
sources.guard: Coverage modelling and published infrastructure data do not prove indoor reception, delivered speed, provider availability or a connection order outcome.

sources.title: Project Gigabit National Rolling Open Market Review May 2026
sources.role: Official market-review consultation outcome for planned broadband coverage.
sources.facts: Published 1 May 2026 and closed 1 June 2026; providers were asked for existing and planned coverage over three years.
sources.guard: Provider submissions and planned coverage do not prove build completion, exact-premises eligibility or future delivery.

sources.title: Electronic communications code operators permitted development right
sources.role: Authoritative planning-data category for electronic communications code operators.
sources.facts: The record identifies permitted-development-right 16A and its authoritative organisation.
sources.guard: A category record does not prove that a proposal meets every condition, notification requirement or prior-approval test.

sources.title: Revised Telecommunications Security Code of Practice 2026 version 1.1
sources.role: Current security compliance guidance for public telecoms providers.
sources.facts: Version 1.1 was issued on 14 July 2026 and provides guidance under telecommunications security legislation.
sources.guard: A security code does not prove a particular provider, network asset or site is compliant, secure or operational.
